select * from "course_bundles" where "slug" = $1 and "deleted_at" is null
select * from "course_bundles" where "status" = $1 and "deleted_at" is null order by "created_at" asc
select * from "courses" where "creator_id" = $1 and "status" = $2 and "deleted_at" is null order by "created_at" desc

select "courses"."id", "courses"."slug", "courses"."title", "courses"."short_description", "courses"."difficulty", "courses"."instructor_alias", "courses"."thumbnail_media_id", (select "thumbnail_media"."metadata" from "media_assets" as "thumbnail_media" where "thumbnail_media"."id" = "courses"."thumbnail_media_id") as "thumbnail_metadata", (select "thumbnail_media"."storage_key" from "media_assets" as "thumbnail_media" where "thumbnail_media"."id" = "courses"."thumbnail_media_id") as "thumbnail_storage_key", "categories"."name" as "category_name", "users"."display_name" as "creator_display_name", "course_pricing"."pricing_type", "course_pricing"."price", "course_pricing"."currency", "course_pricing"."sale_price", "course_settings"."certificate_enabled", "course_settings"."estimated_duration", (select count("id") as "count" from "course_sections" where "course_sections"."course_id" = "courses"."id" and "course_sections"."deleted_at" is null) as "total_sections", (select count("id") as "count" from "course_lessons" where "course_lessons"."course_id" = "courses"."id" and "course_lessons"."is_published" = $1 and "course_lessons"."deleted_at" is null) as "total_lessons", (select coalesce(sum("lesson_media"."duration_seconds"), 0) as "sum" from "course_lessons" left join "media_assets" as "lesson_media" on "lesson_media"."id" = "course_lessons"."content_media_id" where "course_lessons"."course_id" = "courses"."id" and "course_lessons"."is_published" = $2 and "course_lessons"."deleted_at" is null) as "lesson_duration_seconds" from "courses" left join "categories" on "categories"."id" = "courses"."category_id" and "categories"."deleted_at" is null left join "users" on "users"."id" = "courses"."creator_id" and "users"."is_deleted" = $3 left join "course_pricing" on "course_pricing"."course_id" = "courses"."id" left join "course_settings" on "course_settings"."course_id" = "courses"."id" where "courses"."status" = $4 and "courses"."deleted_at" is null order by "courses"."created_at" asc
